# Pulse 1.0.398

- Game Hub: fifty built-in games (Mega Games: Blade Arena, Nebula Voyager, VoxelCraft 3D and more) on the shelf, on by default; a switch in the shelf's settings turns them off.
- Game Hub: the shelf is the only page now; the old settings page, side menu and other looks are gone, and the settings are the shelf's own.
- Game Hub: a search button beside Menu brings the shelf to a game by its name (it does not start it).
- Game Hub: a flick of the shelf glides on and slows down.
- Game Hub: pictures (wide background, logo, four screenshots) and a rating are fetched when the shelf opens; a RAWG key can be given in the shelf's settings.
- Game Hub: a hold on the case takes the disc out at once; the disc has its own print; no dark insert screen is left over the shelf after a game.
- Game Hub: the widget-like "no games" text no longer shows while the games load.
- Music: the shuffle and songs' layout buttons are pictures only; the wave seek bar glides after a flick; the songs' column count goes back to one list.
- Poweramp widget: text size, text side and cover side; each widget size is drawn at its own size.
- Keyboard: faster correction, late fix with a highlight, landscape settings, Samsung look, every new screenshot in the clipboard.
- Pulse AI: smaller native libraries.
